## What's new in v2.0.49

This release brings in four community contributions from **@Vikk20**. Thank you! Each one was reviewed and tested with the rest of the theme before merging.

### Overview: who's actually connected (#6)
The **Clients** card now lists the devices on your Wi-Fi first, strongest signal first, with their signal strength. If you run **usteer** across several access points, stations on the other APs appear too (for example `via Kitchen-AP · -61 dBm`). Wired and idle devices fill the remaining rows. On an access point behind a main router, your own Wi-Fi devices now appear at the top of the card.

The card shows up to ten rows, and the rest are counted. The extra lookups ride in the same single request the Overview already makes every refresh, so there is no added load on the router. Without usteer, the card simply shows this router's own stations and other known devices.

### Overview: tidier layout (#4)
Network Interfaces, Wireless and Storage now sit in one row of equal-height cards, followed by Quick Actions, then Live Throughput beside Clients. No more empty gap under a short card. The layout steps down to two columns, then one, on smaller screens.

### Network Map: readable names (#5)
Device names and details are larger and easier to read. Long names (like `NOMI-IPC-C32S-R0-2B16`) wrap instead of being cut off, so similar devices can be told apart without opening each one.

### Fresh scripts after every theme update (#3)
The page now tags LuCI's script URLs with the theme version as well. Browsers fetch the new UniWRT scripts after an update, however the update was installed.

### Upgrading
Run the install line below again (standalone), or install the new package, then reload the page.
